Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: A PurchaseSuccess notification appears in the Learner's bell right after a successful PayOS payment.
column3: 1. Complete a successful course purchase (SYS_FLOW_ENR_TC11). 2. Open the Learner's notification bell.
column4: A PurchaseSuccess notification is present, referencing the purchased course(s).
column5: A successful payment just completed for this Learner.

Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: A NewEnrollment notification appears in the course-owning Trainer's bell for both paid and free enrollments.
column3: 1. Have a Learner enroll in a Trainer's free course (SYS_FLOW_ENR_TC03) and, separately, purchase a paid course from the same or another Trainer. 2. Open each Trainer's notification bell.
column4: Each Trainer sees a NewEnrollment notification for their respective course, fired from both the free-enroll path (`CourseServiceImpl.enrollCourse`) and the paid webhook path (`PaymentServiceImpl.handlePayOSWebhook`).
column5: A free enrollment and a paid enrollment have both just occurred.

Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: A CommentReply notification appears in the original comment author's bell after someone replies.
column3: 1. Have Learner B reply to Learner A's comment (SYS_FLOW_CMT_TC07). 2. Open Learner A's notification bell.
column4: Learner A has a CommentReply notification referencing the Lesson/comment thread.
column5: A reply to Learner A's comment was just posted.

Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: ContentApproved and ContentRejected notifications appear in the Trainer's bell after Course Manager review decisions.
column3: 1. Have a Course Manager approve one of a Trainer's Courses/Exams and reject another (SYS_FLOW_CRS_TC15/16, SYS_FLOW_EXM_TC07/08). 2. Open that Trainer's notification bell.
column4: One ContentApproved and one ContentRejected notification are present, each identifying the relevant Course/Exam.
column5: Both an approval and a rejection have just occurred for this Trainer's content.

Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: A CourseUpdated notification reaches every Learner enrolled in a prior course version when a new version publishes.
column3: 1. With 2+ Learners enrolled in a course's live version, have the Trainer edit and the Course Manager publish a new version (SYS_FLOW_CRS_TC21-22). 2. Open each enrolled Learner's notification bell.
column4: Every Learner who was enrolled in the prior version has a CourseUpdated notification; a Learner never enrolled in this course has none.
column5: A new course version has just been published over an existing enrolled base.

Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: A StatementReady notification appears in the Trainer's bell when their Monthly Statement is generated.
column3: 1. Have a Course Manager generate the monthly statement cutoff covering this Trainer (SYS_FLOW_REV flow). 2. Open the Trainer's notification bell.
column4: A StatementReady notification is present, referencing the generated statement period/amount.
column5: A monthly statement has just been generated for this Trainer.

Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: A LOW_RATING/LOW_AVERAGE_RATING notification broadcasts to every TRAINER_LEAD account, not just one.
column3: 1. Trigger a low course rating event (e.g. a Learner leaves a 1-star review dragging the average below the threshold, SYS_FLOW_ENR_TC21). 2. Log in as two different TRAINER_LEAD accounts and check each one's bell.
column4: Both TRAINER_LEAD accounts see the LOW_RATING/LOW_AVERAGE_RATING notification (role-broadcast, not per-user targeted).
column5: At least 2 TRAINER_LEAD accounts exist; a low-rating event has just occurred.

Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: The unread badge count matches the real number of unread notifications and decreases as items are read.
column3: 1. Note the unread badge count on the Bell icon. 2. Open the dropdown and click one unread notification. 3. Recheck the badge.
column4: The badge count before matches the number of currently-unread notifications; after reading one, the badge decreases by exactly 1.
column5: At least 2 unread notifications exist for the logged-in user.

Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: Clicking a notification marks it read but does not attempt to navigate anywhere.
column3: 1. Click an unread notification in the dropdown.
column4: The notification's `is_read` flips to true (it visually updates/moves to a read state); the app does not navigate to another page, matching the documented v1 limitation.

Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: "Mark all as read" clears the entire unread badge in one action.
column3: 1. With several unread notifications present, tap "Mark all as read".
column4: All notifications become read; the unread badge drops to 0 immediately.

Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: A user cannot mark another user's per-user notification as read by targeting its ID directly.
column3: 1. Log in as User B. 2. Attempt to mark User A's per-user notification (e.g. PurchaseSuccess) as read by its ID (via a manipulated request, since the UI itself would not normally expose another user's ID).
column4: The action is rejected - ownership is enforced in `NotificationService.markAsRead`; User A's notification remains unread and User B sees no change reflected for it.
column5: User A has an unread per-user notification; User B is a different account.

Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: A role-broadcast notification's read state is shared across every member of that role.
column3: 1. As TRAINER_LEAD account #1, open the dropdown and read the LOW_RATING notification from TC07. 2. Log in as TRAINER_LEAD account #2 and check the same notification.
column4: Once account #1 reads it, the same broadcast notification shows as read for account #2 as well - a single shared `is_read` flag, by design (not a per-recipient gap to report).
column5: The LOW_RATING broadcast from TC07 is currently unread for both accounts.

Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: A notification referencing a deleted course still displays without crashing.
column3: 1. Identify a notification referencing a specific course (e.g. NewEnrollment). 2. Have the course deleted (or simulate via a course id that no longer exists). 3. Reopen the notification list.
column4: The notification is still listed; the course-related fields (courseId/courseTitle) render as null/blank gracefully; tapping it does not crash or attempt broken navigation.
column5: A notification exists that references a course which is then deleted.

Cross-Module Notification Delivery & Rea: The Course Manager's dedicated notification inbox (via Course Manager Dashboard) only shows Course-Manager-targeted notifications.
column3: 1. Log in as TRAINER_LEAD. 2. Open the Course Manager Dashboard's own notification view (distinct from the generic Bell). 3. Compare its contents against the generic per-user Bell for the same account.
column4: The Course Manager Dashboard inbox shows only TRAINER_LEAD-targeted notifications (e.g. LOW_RATING broadcasts, review-queue related items); it does not show unrelated personal notifications meant for other roles.
column5: TRAINER_LEAD account with at least one role-targeted notification.
